format: Markdown documentation with embedded code snippets
description: This is a documentation file (Markdown) for the Logger class within the Playwright project. It provides an overview of the class, its deprecation notice, and code examples demonstrating its usage, along with descriptions of its methods.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: A deprecated logging class in Playwright used for pumping logs through a pluggable logger sink. Usage of this class is discouraged in favor of tracing.

methods.name: Logger.isEnabled
methods.description: Determines whether the logger sink is interested in the logger with the given name and severity.

methods.name: Logger.log
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified severity and optional arguments to the logger sink.
